Medsell
is a medical device marketing and distribution company, while
continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), smartwatches with ECG, and sleep trackers represent consumer and clinical wearable technologies used in remote patient monitoring (RPM)
. Regulatory bodies do not clear smartwatches for non-invasive blood glucose testing, unlike skin-piercing CGM sensors.

Wearable Health Tech Categories
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom use a tiny filament under the skin to read interstitial fluid glucose in real time.
Tenovi | Remote Patient Monitoring
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Consumer items like the Apple Watch record single-lead ECG traces to flag heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation.
Tenovi | Remote Patient Monitoring
Sleep Trackers:
Wristbands or bedside mats monitor movement and heart-rate variability to score sleep phases.
Tenovi | Remote Patient Monitoring
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Systems that relay biometric streams (blood pressure, ECG, glucose) directly to medical teams for chronic care management.
